why_pinned_to_a_commit: A branch name moves under you and makes the artifact unreproducible. The commit sha fixes exactly these bytes.

verified_here.note: Checked with our own instrument rather than accepting the report. A synthetic log of ONE continuous fight spanning 31 Aug 23:59:40 -> 1 Sep 00:00:58 was fed to this bundle.
verified_here.meaning: 1 engagement is the fixed behaviour. The month-boundary defect split a continuous fight in two because the day index ran backwards across a month end.
verified_here.months_seen_note: Emitted as an int, not a list. That was caught by our hand-written contract fixture: the spec said count and the first build shipped the thing being counted.
